name: xiaohei-live2d-desktop-pet
description: Windows desktop pet powered by a local Live2D Luo Xiaohei model.

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on tcp:5180 && electron . --dev-server-url=http://127.0.0.1:5180"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && vite build
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis portable
scripts.smoke: npm run build && playwright test tests/e2e/electron-smoke.spec.ts
